claims.content: Arc-melted HEAs suffer coarse grains and dendritic segregation.
claims.evidence_span: Bulk HEAs are usually prepared by vacuum arc-melting technology, with the disadvantages of coarse grains and dendritic segregation

claims.content: Interstitially driven precipitates may improve HEA properties.
claims.evidence_span: Therefore, the precipitated phase, caused by introduction of interstitial elements, may benefit the mechanical properties of HEAs in some cases.

claims.content: Large Ti atoms improve room- and high-temperature properties.
claims.evidence_span: the addition of Ti with the largest atomic size significantly improves the mechanical properties of HEAs at room and elevated temperature

claims.content: Solid solution, grain boundaries, and TiO precipitation jointly strengthen the alloy.
claims.evidence_span: can be attributed to solid solution strengthening and grain boundary strengthening of the fine-grained BCC matrix, as well as the precipitation strengthening owing to the formation of TiO particles.

claims.content: The bulk alloy reached 2709 MPa yield strength and 11.4 percent strain.
claims.evidence_span: The compressive yield strength, fracture strength, and total fracture strain of the consolidated bulk HEA are 2709 MPa, 3115 MPa, and 11.4%, respectively.

claims.content: TiO particles impede dislocations, increasing strength while reducing ductility.
claims.evidence_span: the precipitated fine TiO particles are likely to impede the dislocation motion in the BCC matrix, thus increasing strength and slightly decreasing the ductility of the alloy

claims.content: Mechanical alloying introduces interstitials and secondary phases.
claims.evidence_span: However, it is inevitable that interstitial elements, such as O, N, etc. will be introduced during the preparing process, which will lead to the formation of precipitated phases

claims.content: Strength gains cost roughly 20 percent ductility.
claims.evidence_span: Notably, the compressive yield strength and fracture strength of the NbMoTaWVTi HEA are 78.8% and 45.9%, respectively, higher than those of the corresponding as-cast HEA, while the ductility decreases about 20%
